reproduction_target: The population-genetic and metagenomic re-analysis of 2 newly sequenced / re-sequenced Neolithic Gotland genomes (SE_TRB_ans017, SE_LN_ans010) merged with published ancient and present-day panels: PCA/Procrustes, unsupervised ADMIXTURE, f3/f4 and qpGraph, DATES admixture dating, conditional nucleotide diversity, ancIBD kinship, imputation + ROH/hapROH, MSMC/rCCR, novel-variant discovery and annotation, fastsimcoal2 demographic modelling, and MALT/MEGAN Yersinia pestis screening. Wet-lab aDNA extraction, library building and Illumina sequencing are out of scope (OOS).
granularity_note: No workflow file (no Snakefile/CWL/Nextflow/WDL/Makefile) and no code repository exist for this paper, so steps were derived from Methods prose at one step per named tool / named analysis invocation, per guide Step 1 fallback. 24 computational steps (C) + 2 wet-lab steps (W). Several Methods paragraphs defer detail to Supplementary sections 2-8 and to Extended Datasets/Tables; supplementary files were NOT parsed at Stage 1, so steps whose specification lives only in the supplement carry the 'needs-supplement' subflag rather than a lower score than the prose supports.

steps.label: aDNA sample preparation, extraction, blunt-end Illumina library building (P5/P7 adapters, IS4 + index primers, 9-15 cycles), plus 12 UDG-treated damage-repaired libraries for ans017
Library quantification (Bioanalyzer 2100 HS / TapeStation 2200) and Illumina sequencing (HiSeq 2500 v4 125bp PE; HiSeq X Ten v2.5 150bp PE) at SNP&SEQ, Uppsala

Raw read processing and reference alignment - 'Sequencing data was processed following Gunther et al. (ref 14) as previously reported (refs 12, 24)'; no trimmer, aligner, reference build or parameter named in this paper

aDNA authentication and contamination estimation from three sources: mitochondrial genome (ref 80), X chromosome for males (refs 81, 82), autosomes (refs 83, 84); read-length and deamination summaries
Biological sexing of SE_LN_ans010 using the Rx method (ref 85)
mtDNA haplogroup classification for SE_TRB_ans017 and SE_LN_ans010 using Haplogrep 3 (v.3.2.1)
Y-chromosome haplogroup assignment from all single base substitutions in ISOGG version 15.73 (11 July 2020); earlier-version calls updated, two PWC calls restricted
Pseudo-haploid genotype sampling for merging with Panels 1-4: one random read per SNP site with min mapping and base quality 30 using Samtools 1.3v mpileup; non-biallelic sites excluded

Principal Component Analysis - smartpca (EIGENSOFT, version not stated) with 'numoutlieriter: 0' and 'r2thresh: 0.2', Human Origins Panel 1 (991 individuals / 67 populations) + 210 published ancient genomes, Procrustes transformation, plotted with an in-house R script using the vegan library

Unsupervised ADMIXTURE v1.3 on 2392 individuals from 213 worldwide Human Origins populations (Yoruba subset for Africa) merged with the ancient individuals; transversion SNPs only; all K reported in Extended Data Fig. 1

Shared-drift f3-statistics with qp3Pop (ADMIXTOOLS, version not stated), SGDP Mbuti outgroup, Panel 2 (individuals) / Panel 4 (groups); distance matrices summarised by MDS with 'cmdscale' from the R 'stats' package (R version not stated)
f4-statistics (ADMIXTOOLS, version not stated) on shotgun-sequenced genome-wide data overlapped with Panel 2; topologies 'dependent on the analysis', enumerated only in Supplementary section 4.4.2

qpGraph (version 6100) admixture-graph fitting against Panel 4 with Mbuti outgroup; acceptance rules stated (|Z| < 3, models with < 15000 SNPs excluded, inner zero-drift branches excluded, terminal zero-drift permitted)

Admixture dating with DATES (version not stated) using 'default parameters as suggested in the github default web page (https://github.com/priyamoorjani/DATES)'; SHG_Motala_CP and DE_LBK_CP proxies, 25 years per generation, negative-generation and high-SE results discarded
Conditional nucleotide diversity per population, computed 'as previously described' (refs 5, 68) on Panel 3 SNPs only; no tool, script or parameter named in the paper prose

Per-sample genotype imputation with GLIMPSE (version not stated) 'following author recommendations (https://odelaneau.github.io/GLIMPSE/docs/tutorials)' using 1000 Genomes phased haplotypes (ftp release 20130502) as reference panel

IBD-based kinship inference (3rd-7th degree) with ancIBD (v.0.2a, https://pypi.org/project/ancIBD) on GLIMPSE-imputed data downsampled to 1,240,000 SNPs, all pairs with >= 0.4x coverage (n = 16) plus two 0.13-0.14x individuals, 'ancIBD recommended default settings'

Diploid imputation for ROH analysis: genotype likelihoods for biallelic autosomal 1000G phase 3 SNPs called with GATK v3.5.0 'UnifiedGenotyper', then Beagle 4.0 imputation of 55 genomes at > 0.7x in 15,000-marker windows using the 1000G phase 3 haplotype reference panel and BEAGLE genetic maps; accuracy assessed against downsampled high-coverage genomes

Runs of Homozygosity from the imputed diploid data following Cassidy et al. (ref 65) track-length categories, plus inbreeding coefficient / HBD fraction for SE_TRB_ans017 following Gazal et al. (ref 92); no tool or script named

hapROH version 0.1a4 (https://pypi.org/project/hapROH) on pseudo-haploid 1240K (Panel 4) data for individuals > 0.3x, default parameters and default genetic map, 5008 1000 Genomes haplotypes as reference

MSMC v.0.1.0 - per-individual effective population size (PSMC-style) on 4 HGDP present-day genomes + UDG-treated SE_TRB_ans017 + 4 published ancients, generation time 30 y, mutation rate 1.25e-8, following the Gunther et al. (ref 14) workflow; plus 2-individual/4-haplotype rCCR runs with recombination rate 0.88, first/last 10 bases downscaled for non-UDG libraries

Novel-variant discovery and annotation in SE_TRB_ans017 - GATK v3.5.0 RealignerTargetCreator + IndelRealigner, then UnifiedGenotyper with '-stand_call_conf 50.0 & -stand_emit_conf 50.0 & -mbq 30 & -contamination 0.02 & --output_mode EMIT_ALL_SITES' and dbSNP version 142 via '--dbsnp'; deleteriousness scored with SIFT and PolyPhen-2 (versions not stated)

Demographic modelling with fastsimcoal2.7 following Marchi et al. (ref 95) on 4 high-coverage genomes; site filtering stated (no missing data, chimp/gorilla reference-allele agreement, CpG removal, recombination rate >= 1 cM/Mb, BGC-free A>T and G>C only, final 112,366,543 sites), 4 competing models, ML parameters from the best of 50 independent runs, 95% CI from 100 parametric bootstrap re-estimations

Metagenomic microbial screening of Ansarve and PWC shotgun data with MALT (version not stated) and MEGAN (version not stated) to build a species absolute-abundance table; no MALT index, database build or parameter stated

Competitive mapping of metagenomic reads to 'relevant reference genomes' with bwa (version, subcommand and parameters not stated; reference genome accessions not stated), then processing and authentication of endogenous Yersinia pestis sequences following Key et al. (ref 98)

Heatmap of shared derived SNVs between this study's mapped reads and 79 ancient and modern Y. pestis sequences, 'generated with R using package heatmap2' (R and package versions not stated; the 79 comparison genomes are not listed with accessions in the prose; plotting script not deposited)

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 11/24 (46%) readiness upper bound = (n_R-star + n_RI)/|S|. All 11 RI steps are RI only because the ENA accession is a literal placeholder ('XXX') and because no analysis code is deposited; every one of them names an exact tool version in prose. If the ENA deposit is released at journal publication, those 11 stay RI (never R-star) because there is no environment lock, no container and no lockfile anywhere in the paper.
